g.text: Church CMS - Whole Project Figma Design Board
Core PHP + MySQL church management system, mapped from the actual route shell, module views, forms, tables, modals, and department portal.
Extracted from Tailwind config and app CSS.
Nunito-style body text, compact labels, dense admin screens.
UPPERCASE KPI LABELS AND TABLE HEADERS

Admin, pastor, accountant, secretary, department head
Calendar, Sunday snapshot, church KPIs, finance
Stats, import, filters, member modal, guest details
Offering categories, weekly tables, upload, reports
Purchase requests linked to approved budgets
SMS compose, recipient selection, delivery history
Church profile, users, roles, approval workflows
Separate department-head experience with dashboard, members, leaders, finance, reports, contributions, and assets.
Core data flows through members, departments, budgets, approvals, procurement, sadaka, attendance, and audit trails.
Register people, capture service data, approve funds, request purchases, manage ministry resources, and report activity.
Enter your credentials to access the system
Register, manage and import congregation members.
Overview, income, expenses, pledges, budgets, approvals, and reports.
Offering categories, weekly member contribution grid, upload, reports, and member entry management.
Representative frames for workflow-heavy modules sharing the same admin shell patterns.

Department head view with the same royal/glory visual language.
At mobile widths, sidebar becomes a drawer, the top bar keeps the title and avatar, KPI grids collapse to two columns then one, and tables move into horizontal scroll or stacked cards.
